gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian moves in loose, rope-like curves that never knot. Comfortaa above it has no calligraphic shading, just uniform tubing, so the body text can stay modest in size while the heading keeps all the attention.
gen-comfortaa-gf-pontano-sans: Neon-tube roundness up top, tidy openness below. Comfortaa draws its bowls and stems in a single stroke width, while Pontano Sans leaves its c terminals generously open, so heading and text read like one voice at two volumes.
gen-comfortaa-gf-quattrocento-sans: Comfortaa stretches its letters like an uncoiled spring. Quattrocento Sans keeps its gaps distinct so c never slides into o, which makes extended reading feel tidy and modern once the heading is done showing off.
gen-comfortaa-gf-rosario: A c like a wide-open ring and neon-tube strokes make Comfortaa instantly recognizable, with spacing stretched like an uncoiled spring. Rosario's ends never turn inward, so the pair stays friendly throughout.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sarala: Comfortaa's ring-shaped c looks drawn in neon tube. Sarala follows with distinct gaps in its letters and a thickness like neon glass tubing, so paragraphs read smoothly without ever feeling cold or stiff.
gen-comfortaa-gf-source-sans-3: Friendly from the first letter, Comfortaa draws every stroke at a thickness that never shifts, whatever the curves do. Source Sans 3 lets its a breathe, so text can shrink comfortably.
gen-comfortaa-gf-special-gothic: Special Gothic reads rounded and inviting, a gentle counterpart to Comfortaa and its ribbon of constant width. Comfortaa earns its keep when it is big and the line is short.
gen-comfortaa-gf-stick: Tube-thin lines, wide-open rings, zero fuss. Comfortaa sets the neon mood, and Stick keeps its tubelike lines with exits wide enough to pass light, so paragraphs flow with little effort.
gen-comfortaa-gf-suse: SUSE reads approachable and soft, its curves carrying the heft of a rope and its bowls tipped open like a ladle. Under Comfortaa's neon rings, the paragraphs feel unhurried and easy.
gen-comfortaa-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, giving the text a light touch. And Comfortaa's round-tipped pen lines give the heading a friendly warmth that TASA Explorer carries through.
